title: resQ evidence overview
description: One-stop dashboard over the resQ normalized table-v2 ingestion path: pass/fail and duration trends, coverage by labeled basis, flake and quarantine debt, benchmark verdicts, and deployment correlation. Every panel query is executed by tools/verify_ingestion_contract.py.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service AS __text, service AS __value FROM resq_runs WHERE service <> '' ORDER BY service

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment AS __text, environment AS __value FROM resq_runs WHERE environment <> '' AND (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR service = ${service:sqlstring}) ORDER BY environment

list.name: branch
list.label: Branch
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vcs_branch AS __text, vcs_branch AS __value FROM resq_runs WHERE vcs_branch <> '' AND (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR service = ${service:sqlstring}) ORDER BY vcs_branch

target.rawSql:
SELECT MIN(r.finished_at) AS time,
       'deploy ' || r.deployment_id || ' (' || r.vcs_branch || ' @ ' ||
       SUBSTR(r.vcs_sha, 1, 8) || ')' AS text
FROM resq_runs AS r
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND r.deployment_id <> ''
GROUP BY r.deployment_id, r.vcs_branch, r.vcs_sha
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Pass rate
panels.description: Passed tests as a share of executed tests in the latest run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.run_id, r.finished_at, r.test_count, r.pass_count,
       r.fail_count + r.error_count AS failures, r.skip_count,
       CASE WHEN r.test_count = 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 100.0 * r.pass_count / r.test_count END AS pass_rate,
       r.duration_seconds,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resq_tests AS t WHERE t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.flaky) AS flaky_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resq_tests AS t WHERE t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.quarantine_active) AS active_quarantines,
       (SELECT c.function_percent FROM resq_coverage_runs AS c WHERE c.run_id = r.run_id) AS function_percent
FROM resq_runs AS r WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring})
ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Tests executed in the latest run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.run_id, r.finished_at, r.test_count, r.pass_count,
       r.fail_count + r.error_count AS failures, r.skip_count,
       CASE WHEN r.test_count = 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 100.0 * r.pass_count / r.test_count END AS pass_rate,
       r.duration_seconds,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resq_tests AS t WHERE t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.flaky) AS flaky_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resq_tests AS t WHERE t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.quarantine_active) AS active_quarantines,
       (SELECT c.function_percent FROM resq_coverage_runs AS c WHERE c.run_id = r.run_id) AS function_percent
FROM resq_runs AS r WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring})
ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Function coverage
panels.description: Gate-basis function coverage of the latest covered run. No implied target: thresholds belong to your gate config.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.run_id, r.finished_at, r.test_count, r.pass_count,
       r.fail_count + r.error_count AS failures, r.skip_count,
       CASE WHEN r.test_count = 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 100.0 * r.pass_count / r.test_count END AS pass_rate,
       r.duration_seconds,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resq_tests AS t WHERE t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.flaky) AS flaky_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resq_tests AS t WHERE t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.quarantine_active) AS active_quarantines,
       (SELECT c.function_percent FROM resq_coverage_runs AS c WHERE c.run_id = r.run_id) AS function_percent
FROM resq_runs AS r WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring})
ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Pass rate
panels.description: Share of executed tests that passed, per run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time,
       CASE WHEN r.test_count = 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 100.0 * r.pass_count / r.test_count END AS pass_rate
FROM resq_runs AS r WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
ORDER BY r.finished_at

panels.title: Failures, errors, flakes, skips
panels.description: Failed = assertion mismatch; errored = crashed/timed out; flaky = passed only after retry; skipped = not executed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time, r.fail_count AS failed, r.error_count AS errored,
       r.skip_count AS skipped,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resq_tests AS t
         WHERE t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.flaky) AS flaky
FROM resq_runs AS r WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
ORDER BY r.finished_at

panels.title: Run duration
panels.description: Wall-clock duration of each run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time, r.duration_seconds
FROM resq_runs AS r WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
ORDER BY r.finished_at

panels.title: Tests and assertions per run
panels.description: Suite growth over time: executed tests and assertions per run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time, r.test_count AS tests, r.assertion_count AS assertions
FROM resq_runs AS r WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
ORDER BY r.finished_at

panels.title: Coverage by basis
panels.description: Function, line, statement, and branch coverage are different bases and are deliberately separate series; never merge them into one trend. Statement/branch percentages are only trustworthy alongside their instrumentation completeness (next panel).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time, c.function_percent, c.line_percent,
       c.statement_site_percent, c.branch_percent
FROM resq_coverage_runs AS c JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = c.run_id
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
ORDER BY r.finished_at

panels.title: Instrumentation completeness
panels.description: How much of the eligible statement/branch surface was actually instrumented. Dashed to mark it as the qualifier for the same-hued basis series in the previous panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time,
       c.statement_site_instrumentation_percent AS statement_completeness,
       c.branch_instrumentation_percent AS branch_completeness
FROM resq_coverage_runs AS c JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = c.run_id
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
ORDER BY r.finished_at

panels.title: Least-covered files (latest run)
panels.description: Files with the lowest function coverage in the latest covered run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.file_path, f.function_hit, f.function_found,
       CASE WHEN f.function_found = 0 THEN 100.0
            ELSE 100.0 * f.function_hit / f.function_found END AS function_percent,
       f.line_hit, f.line_found, f.loaded
FROM resq_coverage_files AS f
JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = f.run_id
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND r.finished_at = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.finished_at) FROM resq_runs AS r2
    JOIN resq_coverage_runs AS c2 ON c2.run_id = r2.run_id WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r2.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r2.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r2.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY function_percent, f.file_path LIMIT 25

panels.title: Slowest tests (latest run)
panels.description: Longest-running tests in the latest matching run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.suite, t.description, t.duration_seconds, t.attempts, t.file_path
FROM resq_tests AS t JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = t.run_id
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND r.finished_at = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.finished_at) FROM resq_runs AS r2 WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r2.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r2.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r2.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY t.duration_seconds DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Most-failing tests (selected range)
panels.description: Tests with failures or flaky passes inside the selected time range, grouped by stable identity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.suite, t.description,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('fail', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures,
       SUM(CASE WHEN t.flaky THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flaky_passes,
       COUNT(*) AS runs, MAX(r.finished_at) AS last_seen
FROM resq_tests AS t JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = t.run_id
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
GROUP BY t.test_id, t.case_id, t.suite, t.description
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.status IN ('fail', 'error') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
    OR SUM(CASE WHEN t.flaky THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY failures DESC, flaky_passes DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Per-test history
panels.description: Raw per-test drill-down feed: every execution in the selected range with stable IDs, status, and duration. Filterable columns.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time, t.test_id, t.case_id, t.suite, t.description,
       t.status, t.duration_seconds, t.file_path
FROM resq_tests AS t JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = t.run_id
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
ORDER BY r.finished_at, t.test_id, t.case_id

panels.title: Quarantine and retry debt
panels.description: Standing debt per run: actively quarantined tests and tests that needed retries.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resq_tests AS t
         WHERE t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.quarantine_active) AS active_quarantines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resq_tests AS t
         WHERE t.run_id = r.run_id AND t.retried) AS retried_tests
FROM resq_runs AS r WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
ORDER BY r.finished_at

panels.title: Active quarantines (latest run)
panels.description: Active quarantines in the latest run with owner, reason, and expiry.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.suite, t.description, t.status, t.quarantine_state,
       t.quarantine_owner, t.quarantine_reason, t.quarantine_expires_at
FROM resq_tests AS t JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = t.run_id
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND t.quarantine_active AND r.finished_at = (
    SELECT MAX(r2.finished_at) FROM resq_runs AS r2 WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r2.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r2.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r2.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY t.quarantine_expires_at, t.suite, t.description

panels.title: Benchmark medians
panels.description: Median sample time per benchmark identity. Series colors follow Grafana's theme palette because the series set is dynamic.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time, b.suite || ' :: ' || b.description AS metric,
       b.med_time_ms AS value
FROM resq_benchmarks AS b JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = b.run_id
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
ORDER BY r.finished_at, b.benchmark_id

panels.title: Benchmark verdicts per run
panels.description: Statistical gate verdicts per run (Mann-Whitney + Holm with a practical-effect threshold). Inconclusive usually means an environment or sample-size mismatch, not health.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.comparison_class = 'regressed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS regressed,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.comparison_class = 'inconclusive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconclusive,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.comparison_class = 'improved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS improved,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.comparison_class = 'stable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stable
FROM resq_benchmarks AS b JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = b.run_id
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
GROUP BY r.finished_at ORDER BY r.finished_at

panels.title: Branch/deployment/host correlation
panels.description: Run-level correlation record: branch, commit, deployment, artifact digest, host, q build, and CI pipeline. Correlate by artifact digest or deployment id; branch name alone is not sufficient.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time, r.service, r.environment, r.deployment_id,
       r.artifact_digest, r.vcs_sha, r.vcs_branch, r.hostname, r.q_version,
       r.os, r.ci_provider, r.ci_pipeline_id, r.fail_count, r.error_count
FROM resq_runs AS r WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
ORDER BY r.finished_at DESC

panels.title: Framework diagnostics per run
panels.description: Framework hygiene diagnostics per run (pollution, resource leaks, reporter issues).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.severity = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.severity = 'warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS warnings
FROM resq_diagnostics AS d JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = d.run_id
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(r.finished_at)
GROUP BY r.finished_at ORDER BY r.finished_at

panels.title: Coverage by test context
panels.description: Opt-in per-test coverage attribution (-cov-contexts): which test contexts produced how many hits, by metric kind.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.finished_at AS time, c.context_id, c.test_id, t.status, m.kind,
       SUM(m.hits) AS hits
FROM resq_coverage_contexts AS c
JOIN resq_runs AS r ON r.run_id = c.run_id
LEFT JOIN resq_tests AS t ON t.run_id = c.run_id AND t.test_id = c.test_id
JOIN resq_coverage_context_metrics AS m
  ON m.coverage_context_key = c.coverage_context_key
WHERE (${service:sqlstring} = '' OR r.service = ${service:sqlstring}) AND (${environment:sqlstring} = '' OR r.environment = ${environment:sqlstring}) AND (${branch:sqlstring} = '' OR r.vcs_branch = ${branch:sqlstring})
GROUP BY r.finished_at, c.context_id, c.test_id, t.status, m.kind
ORDER BY r.finished_at, c.context_id, m.kind
